_about: Which layout of the plans editor the 3D model shows on each floor (the option key); floors not listed show their first layout ('a'). Room names are shown only when they are made of everyday room words; anything else is replaced by the room type, so no personal name reaches the model.

open_areas.name: Pool deck
open_areas.src: Architect's ground floor plan (A105, the as-built 1st floor): the pool and its paved deck west of grid C and south of row 4 are open, with the gym's glazing on C and the cafe to the north; the renders show the deck open behind a glass balustrade. null = to the slab edge.

open_areas.name: Roof terrace between the penthouses
open_areas.src: Architect's sixth floor plan (A110, the as-built 7th floor): between the penthouses (C-F and H-M) F to H is roof terrace with planters; the as-built roof outline covers its western half, so that half is a covered terrace.
